mapper.select:
select count(1) from CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub left join chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.RAISE_CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ifnull(prddeal.PRDQTY,0) "prdqty", ifnull(prdrate.PROD_VALUE,1) "prdvalue", ifnull(prdrate.ccy,prddeal.posccy) "raiseccy", prddeal.prod_id "prodid" from ( select sum(prdposition.BALANCE_QTY) PRDQTY,/*取产品头寸的剩余份额，按照同一产品同一币种同一天去汇总*/ prdposition.prod_id prod_id, prdposition.ccy posccy from chb_prd_position prdposition where 1 =1 and DATE_FORMAT(prdposition.CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by prdposition.prod_id,prdposition.ccy ) prddeal left join ( select prdrate.prod_id prod_id, prdrate.PROD_VALUE prod_value, prdrate.CCY CCY, rank() over (partition by prdrate.prod_id order by prdrate.CHANGE_DATE desc) ranknum from chb_prd_periodyield prdrate where 1 =1
and prdrate.CHANG_TYPE = '01' /*变动类型=净值变动*/ and DATE_FORMAT(prdrate.CHANGE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )prdrate on prddeal.prod_id = prdrate.prod_id and prdrate.ranknum = 1 left join chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo on prdinfo.prod_id = prddeal.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, assetposition.PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT,/*资产持仓*/ assetposition.PRD_BALHOLD_AMT PRD_BALHOLD_AMT,/*负债持仓*/ assetposition.ccy ASSET_HOLD_CCY/*资产负债持仓币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select assetposition.prod_id prod_id, SUM(case ifnull(assetinfosub.asset_type2,'NULLTYPE') when 'NULLTYPE' then 0 when 'REMAININGCASH' then 0 when '1901' then assetposition.ACCUAMT when '1902' then assetposition.ACCUAMT when '2000' then assetposition.ACCUAMT else 0 end ) PRD_BALHOLD_AMT, SUM(case ifnull(assetinfosub.asset_type2,'NULLTYPE') when 'NULLTYPE' then 0 when 'REMAININGCASH' then 0 when '1901' then 0 when '1902' then 0 when '2000' then 0 else assetposition.ACCUAMT end ) PRD_ASTHOLD_AMT, assetposition.ccy ccy from chb_asset_position assetposition left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = assetposition.asset_code and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') where 1 =1
and assetposition.CHL_ID = assetposition.ASSET_CODE and assetposition.CHL_ID is not null
and assetposition.CHL_ID != assetposition.ASSET_CODE and assetposition.CHL_ID is not null
and DATE_FORMAT(assetposition.cdate ,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by assetposition.prod_id,assetposition.CCY/*产品+币种汇总*/ )assetposition on assetposition.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, prdraisesub.SUBSCRIBE_CCY_AMT SUBSCRIBE_CCY_AMT/*认购币种及金额*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and prdraisesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(prdraisesub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, prddealsub.CCY_PURCHASE CCY_PURCHASE,/*存续期交易币种及申购兑付金额*/ prddealsub.MDATE raiseEnddate from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select prddealsub.prod_id, prddealsub.CCY_PURCHASE CCY_PURCHASE, prddealsub.MDATE MDATE from chb_prd_deal_sub prddealsub where 1 =1
and prddealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(prddealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )prddealsub on prddealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, ifnull(assetdealsub.PRD_ASSET_AMT,0) PRD_ASSET_AMT,/*交易登记金额*/ assetdealsub.ccy PRD_ASSET_CCY/*交易登记币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join ( select assetdealsub.prod_id, SUM(assetdealsub.AMT*(case assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE when '02' then 1 when '04' then 1 when '06' then 1 when '07' then 1 when '09' then 1 when '11' then 1 else -1 end )) PRD_ASSET_AMT, assetdealsub.CCY CCY from chb_invest_trade_sub assetdealsub where 1 =1
and assetdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12') and DATE_FORMAT(assetdealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by assetdealsub.prod_id,assetdealsub.CCY/*产品+币种汇总*/ )assetdealsub on assetdealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select issuesub.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, issuesub.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME RAISE_REGDATE, (case prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME when null then '02' else '01' end ) IS_REG, case when ifnull(prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME,#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE})>prdraisetotalsub.CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE then '01' else '02' end RAISE_IS_DELAY from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id left join chb_prd_raisetot_sub prdraisetotalsub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisetotalsub.prod_id and prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(prdraisetotalsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/
and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/ and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, sum(ifnull(BOT_ASSET_AMT,0)) BOT_ASSET_AMT, sum(ifnull(BOT_DEBT_AMT,0)) BOT_DEBT_AMT, CHECK_DATE from( select assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, (case bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO when null then '02' else '01' end) IS_REG, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM BOT_ISSUE_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT BOT_ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, (case ifnull(bottomassetsub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET') when '1901' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT when '1902' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT when '2000' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT else 0 end) BOT_DEBT_AMT, (case ifnull(bottomassetsub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET') when '1901' then 0 when '1902' then 0 when '2000' then 0 when 'NOASSET' then 0 else bottomassetsub.POS_AMT end) BOT_ASSET_AMT, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE CHECK_DATE from chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub left join ( select investdealsub.asset_code asset_code,sum((case investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE when '01' then 1 else -1 end)*investdealsub.num) asset_deal_num from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.dealdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by investdealsub.asset_code ) assetdeal on assetinfosub.asset_code = assetdeal.asset_code left join ( select bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO REGIST_SEQNO, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM TOTAL_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH UNINVEST_CASH, bottomassetsub.POS_AMT POS_AMT, bottomassetsub.plan_asset_id plan_asset_id, subassetinfo.asset_type2 asset_type2, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE from chb_bot_ast_pos_sub bottomassetsub left join chb_asset_info_sub subassetinfo on subassetinfo.asset_code = bottomassetsub.asset_code
and subassetinfo.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(subassetinfo.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') where 1 =1
and bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(bottomassetsub.pos_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )bottomassetsub on bottomassetsub.plan_asset_id = assetinfosub.asset_code where assetinfosub.asset_type in ('12','16','19')
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and assetdeal.asset_deal_num > 0 ) cc
group by asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, CHECK_DATE

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_INS_ID PRD_INS_ID, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, prdinfo.RAISE_VDATE RAISE_STARTDATE, prdinfo.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdinfo.VDATE PRD_VDATE, assetdeal.asset_type2 asset_type2, assetdeal.asset_code asset_code, assetdeal.asset_deal_num+initposition.AST_HOLD_NUM AST_HOLD_NUM,/*资产持仓需加上初始持仓*/ (case ifnull(issuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO') when 'NOSEQNO' then '02' else '01' end) IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') ) left join ( select investdealsub.prod_id prod_id, assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, assetinfosub.asset_type2 asset_type2, sum((case investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE when '01' then 1 when '03' then 1 when '05' then 1 else -1 end)*ifnull(investdealsub.num,0)) asset_deal_num from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = investdealsub.asset_code where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','07')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.dealdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(assetinfosub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code,assetinfosub.asset_type2 ) assetdeal on assetdeal.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id left join chb_totalcheck_detail initposition on initposition.totalseqno = '111111111111111111111111111111111111'/*初始持仓默认36个1*/ and initposition.prd_id = prdinfo.prod_id and initposition.ASSET_CODE = assetdeal.asset_code where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.PROD_INS_ID PRD_INS_ID, prdinfo.PROD_NAME PRD_NAME, prdinfo.RAISE_VDATE RAISE_STARTDATE, prdinfo.RAISE_ENDDATE RAISE_ENDDATE, prdinfo.VDATE PRD_VDATE, ifnull(prdraisesub.TOTAL_AMT,0) - ifnull(assetdealsub.PRD_ASSET_AMT,0) PRD_CASHHOLD_AMT, (case ifnull(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO') when 'NOSEQNO' then '02' else '01' end) IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB prdissuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdissuesub.prod_id and prdissuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(prdissuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub prdendsub where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and prdendsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and prdissuesub.prod_id = prdendsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(prdendsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') ) left join CHB_PRD_RAISETOT_SUB prdraisesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdraisesub.prod_id and prdraisesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(prdraisesub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') left join ( select assetdealsub.prod_id,sum( (case assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE when '01' then 1 when '03' then 1 when '05' then 1 when '08' then 1 when '10' then 1 when '12' then 1 else -1 end)*ifnull(assetdealsub.CNY_AMT,0)) PRD_ASSET_AMT from chb_invest_trade_sub assetdealsub where 1 =1
and assetdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and assetdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12') and DATE_FORMAT(assetdealsub.dealdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(assetdealsub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') group by assetdealsub.prod_id )assetdealsub on assetdealsub.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select prddealsub.prod_id "prodid", CCY_PURCHASE "ccycash" from chb_prd_deal_sub prddealsub where 1 =1
and prddealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(prddealsub.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(prddealsub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, assetdeal.asset_code asset_code, sum((case assetdeal.rowindexlast when 1 then assetdeal.unit_price else 0 end)) AST_MAX_UPRICE, sum((case assetdeal.rowindexfirst when 1 then assetdeal.unit_price else 0 end)) AST_MIN_UPRICE, (case ifnull(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO') when 'NOSEQNO' then '02' else '01' end) IS_ISSUE_REG from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB prdissuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = prdissuesub.prod_id and prdissuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(prdissuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub prdendsub where 1 =1 and prdendsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and prdissuesub.prod_id = prdendsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(prdendsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') ) left join ( select * from( select investdealsub.prod_id prod_id, assetinfosub.asset_code asset_code, if( investdealsub.num=0,0,investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num) unit_price, rank() over (partition by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code order by if( investdealsub.num=0,0,investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num) desc) rowindexlast, rank() over (partition by investdealsub.prod_id,assetinfosub.asset_code order by if( investdealsub.num=0,0,investdealsub.CNY_AMT/investdealsub.num) asc) rowindexfirst from chb_invest_trade_sub investdealsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on assetinfosub.asset_code = investdealsub.asset_code where 1 = 1 and investdealsub.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07','08')
and investdealsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.dealdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(investdealsub.submit_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )as T where rowindexlast = 1 or rowindexfirst = 1 ) assetdeal on assetdeal.prod_id = prdinfo.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by prdinfo.prod_id,assetdeal.asset_code,(case ifnull(prdissuesub.REGIST_SEQNO,'NOSEQNO') when 'NOSEQNO' then '02' else '01' end)

select asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, sum(BOT_ASSET_AMT) BOT_ASSET_AMT, sum(BOT_DEBT_AMT) BOT_DEBT_AMT, CHECK_DATE, '01' IS_REG, '01' IS_DEVIATION from( select bottomassetsub.PLAN_ASSET_ID asset_code, (case bottomassetsub.REGIST_SEQNO when null then '02' else '01' end) IS_REG, bottomassetsub.TOTAL_NUM BOT_ISSUE_NUM, bottomassetsub.ISSUE_AMT BOT_ISSUE_AMT, bottomassetsub.UNINVEST_CASH BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, (case ifnull(assetinfosub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET') when '1901' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT when '1902' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT when '2000' then bottomassetsub.POS_AMT else 0 end) BOT_DEBT_AMT, (case ifnull(assetinfosub.asset_type2 ,'NOASSET') when '1901' then 0 when '1902' then 0 when '2000' then 0 when 'NOASSET' then 0 else bottomassetsub.POS_AMT end) BOT_ASSET_AMT, bottomassetsub.POS_DATE CHECK_DATE
from chb_bot_ast_pos_sub bottomassetsub left join chb_asset_info_sub assetinfosub on bottomassetsub.asset_code = assetinfosub.asset_code
and assetinfosub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(assetinfosub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') where 1 =1
and bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and DATE_FORMAT(bottomassetsub.SUBMIT_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(bottomassetsub.pos_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{monthEndDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )as t
group by asset_code, IS_REG, BOT_ISSUE_NUM, BOT_ISSUE_AMT, BOT_UNINVEST_CASH, CHECK_DATE

select prdinfo.prod_id prd_id, prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE OPERATE_MODE, initposition.PRD_CASHHOLD_AMT PRD_INIT_AMT,/*初始剩余现金*/ initposition.INIT_CCY INIT_CCY /*初始剩余现金币种*/ from chb_prd_baseinfo prdinfo left join chb_totalcheck_detail initposition on initposition.totalseqno = '111111111111111111111111111111111111'/*初始持仓默认36个1*/ and initposition.prd_id = prdinfo.prod_id left join CHB_PRD_ISSUE_SUB issuesub on prdinfo.prod_id = issuesub.prod_id where 1 =1 and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and ifnull(prdinfo.fprod_id,'NULLFP') = 'NULLFP'/*过滤母产品*/
and prdinfo.ISSUING_STATUS = '01'/*发行状态=发行成功*/ and prdinfo.status in ('E','M')/*有效状态：有效、修改*/ and initposition.SEQNO is not null
and issuesub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/
and DATE_FORMAT(issuesub.PRD_VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from chb_prd_end_sub endsub where 1 =1 and endsub.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03'/*反馈状态=中债通过*/ and issuesub.prod_id = endsub.prod_id
and DATE_FORMAT(endsub.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{queryDate,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') )
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('03','04')
and prdinfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01','02')
#{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
